free_tier.stated: None for inference: 'You may not launch GPU instances nor storage volumes, or use Inference, with a free-tier account.' A personal account becomes Pro with a one-time deposit of USD 5 or more, and requests made with an Organization API key do not require Pro.

tooling: OpenAI SDKs with base URL https://api.hyperbolic.ai/inference/v1 and an sk_live_ key; text models only
chaining: pay-per-token text models behind an OpenAI-compatible base URL; the USD 5 deposit is a one-off, with no subscription

limits.value: 300 requests per minute per API key; above that the API returns HTTP 429
a one-time deposit of USD 5 or more upgrades a personal account to Pro, and the credit balance must stay above zero (HTTP 402 when it does not)

binding_note: inference is refused outright on the Free Tier (HTTP 403 inference_requires_pro), so the first constraint is the USD 5 deposit, not a rate

identity_cost.detail: signup verifies an email address, and inference needs a one-time deposit of at least USD 5 made through a payment form before any call; the payment methods that form accepts are not listed on the pages read

confidence_note: documentation pages only; the 300 requests per minute ceiling is a documented figure and not measured

evidence.proved: the Free Tier cannot use inference
evidence.quote: You may not launch GPU instances nor storage volumes, or use [Inference](/docs/inference/overview), with a free-tier account.

evidence.proved: inference needs a Pro plan (a one-time deposit of USD 5 or more) or an Organization
evidence.quote: A Pro plan, or an Organization. Personal accounts on the Free Tier can't use inference. To upgrade, make a one-time deposit of \$5 or more.
[Sign up for Hyperbolic](https://app.hyperbolic.ai), then verify your email address.

evidence.proved: the upgrade is a payment form for USD 5
evidence.quote: an Upgrade to Pro dialog opens with your message, a Free vs Pro comparison, and a $5 payment form

evidence.proved: the previous inference API at api.hyperbolic.xyz is decommissioned and returns 404
evidence.quote: Requests to `https://api.hyperbolic.xyz/v1` now return `404` with a message that the endpoint was decommissioned.

evidence.proved: the previous inference API included the Free Tier and the current one needs a Pro plan or an Organization
evidence.quote: | Plan | Free Tier included | Pro plan or Organization |

evidence.proved: the inference API returns 429 above 300 requests per minute per key
evidence.quote: | `429` | The API key sent more than 300 requests in a minute | Retry with exponential backoff. For a higher limit, [contact sales](mailto:sales@hyperbolic.ai) |

evidence.proved: a Free Tier personal account gets 403 inference_requires_pro
evidence.quote: | `403` | `inference_requires_pro` | The personal account is on the Free Tier | Upgrade with a one-time \$5 deposit under Settings > Plan, or use an Organization API key |

notes: GPU rental by the same vendor is a separate offer (compute/hyperbolic). The previous inference API at api.hyperbolic.xyz included the Free Tier and is decommissioned, returning 404; the current API needs a Pro plan or an Organization.
